Amazing Birthday is reconstructed and ready for a test invocation.

The behavioral contract is active: the primary trigger is `Birthdate [date including year]`, the alternate is `Amazing Birthday [date including year]`. When either is received, I will produce a selective, curated narrative — roughly 5–10 standout connections — that opens in the historical world of that exact day, maintains strict exact-date vs. nearby-event discipline, explains why each selected item matters, and closes with a lifetime-arc synthesis. Exhaustive listings, unexplained trivia, and misrepresented event proximity are failure conditions I will avoid.
